title: Battling the Unbelief of Anxiety
description: In this sermon, the preacher discusses the promise made by Jesus that if we prioritize God's purposes in our lives, He will meet all our needs. The preacher emphasizes the importance of faith in believing this promise. He refers to a passage in Philippians 4 and Matthew 6 to provide examples of battling unbelief and overcoming anxiety. The preacher highlights the issue of anxiety about food and clothing and how it can be rooted in unbelief. He encourages listeners to trust in God's promises and seek His kingdom and righteousness first.
